prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Lavanasura or Lawdasura, the Ramayana asura who uproots and hurls trees.
ANATOMY: ONE powerful adult male humanlike asura figure, one head, TWO eyes, TWO arms and TWO legs; fierce human face, dark hair, fully opaque earth-red layered tunic, loose trousers and simple unmarked bronze armguards. No horns, wings, fangs, extra eyes or limbs invented. Restraint in unspecified body form; identity as asura [lawdasura-c01].
MOMENT: Throw ONE huge freshly UPROOTED TREE toward viewer with both hands, roots and clods of soil at nearest foreground, trunk sweeping diagonally overhead. Full humanlike body braced in twisting throw, mouth sternly open, tree weight visibly impossible for ordinary person; show no person struck and no trident in hand during this fight.
POWER: During fight he uproots and throws trees [lawdasura-c06]. Physical tree roots/soil/dust only; do NOT add fire or spear effects, since this moment shows him without invincible weapon c05.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; very low close action, tree rootmass foreshortened near camera and thrower face prominent above; normal humanlike scale with massive whole tree as strength evidence.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant cold moon or source fire if documented, deep walnut shadows, strong rim light; ordinary physical dust or spray.
SURFACE: tactile skin, coarse fully opaque cloth, wet hair, wood and stone; premium painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Madhu forest near Yamuna plain, choose forest from c12 [lawdasura-c12].
MOOD: imposing active encounter, never cute, calm or decorative; sacred gods depicted reverently and majestically.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoletters, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity, blood or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: Lavanasura or Lawdasura, the Ramayana asura who uproots and hurls trees

visual_requirements.description: Humanlike restrained asura figure, exact body unspecified
Uproots and throws trees during fight, no trident

aura: Documented appearance/deed provides presence, no generic aura.
artistic_choices: Humanlike body/opaque attire editorial, no horns or multilimbs added. Physical documented tree throw differentiates from ordinary warrior. Keep battle accounts c10/c12 different, only take c12 forest setting.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: one humanlike asura head/two eyes/two arms gripping a whole uprooted tree; two braced legs, opaque red tunic and trousers. Rootmass thrust toward viewer with soil clods; physical c06 tree throw, no trident/fire or injured target. Small distant bystander stays safe in background, no giant scale claimed. Face and impossible tree weight make action imposing. No text/aura; all Sangar criteria pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and face, near-hand, upper-hand, armguard/belt and both-foot crops. One humanlike asura (lawdasura-c01) with one head, two eyes, a snarling open mouth, a heavy beard and wild long black hair; the red forehead mark is an editorial detail. Two arms. The near arm, in an engraved bronze armguard, grips the trunk with its fingers dug into the bark; the thumb is hidden behind the trunk, not malformed. The far arm reaches up behind the trunk, and its yellow cord is a tied thread, not text. Two braced legs: the front foot is in a metal-banded greave inside the dust cloud, and the rear foot is in a sandal with toes visible. Opaque red wrap and trousers. No horns, fangs, extra limbs or trident (fights without the trident, c05). Moment: he wrenches a whole freshly uprooted tree and hurls its huge root mass, flying clods and dust at the camera (uproots trees and throws them, c06). This is a physical, documented effect with no fire or aura. The setting is a riverside forest under a moon (Madhu forest, c12). A small bystander far off by the water gives scale without becoming a victim. The armguard and belt ornament is scrollwork, not letters. The tree's impossible weight, the snarl and the low, foreshortened root mass make him clearly superhuman and dangerous at 200px, not an ordinary warrior. No borrowed design.
